`final class Lwjgl3Backend`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Backend`](/reference/backends/backend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl3` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl3` · **Source:** [Lwjgl3Backend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl3/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl3/Lwjgl3Backend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The backend for LWJGL 3, which draws with OpenGL into a GLFW window and plays sound with the OpenAL of LWJGL 3.

## Description

Create the window and make its context current, then register the backend; it attaches the input handlers of the window itself.

## Learn more

- [Start a backend](/use/learn/running/backends/#start-a-backend)

## Property details

<a id="Lwjgl3Backend-property-binding"></a>

### binding

- `this binding(IGlBinding binding)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Default:** `Lwjgl3GlBinding.inst()`

The OpenGL binding that the render bridge calls, [`Lwjgl3GlBinding`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3glbinding/) by default; set another one before `register()` to wrap or replace the OpenGL calls.
